a.text: The answer: Interrupts: the process sleeps, another runs, and the

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: device interrupts when it is done; on xv6, 106 requests cost 106

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: sleeps and 106 interrupts. DMA: the device copies the data itself

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: from an address it is given; xv6's descriptors give the disk the

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: address of b->data, and the CPU touches none of its 1,024 bytes.
